{{Quote|I'm an Imperial stormtrooper, Lieutenant. I live or die at the pleasure of my superiors and my commander.|Lhagva|<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref>}}
'''Lhagva''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Stromma]] who served the [[Empire of the Hand]], as part of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] contingent that was assigned to the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]''.

==Biography==
{{Quote|If Nuso Esva isn't stopped, it's the only possible outcome. If he succeeds in holding the Red City, it'll be only a matter of time before he also takes the White City, then the Black City, and then the entire planet.|Lhagva|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], the leader of the Empire of the Hand, began planning to launch an attack on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]], against the combined forces of the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] and the [[Quesoth]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. However, the Stromma envoy [[Nyama]] believed that the Imperials would be defeated during the attack, so he ordered all of the Stromma aboard the ''Admonitor'' to leave the ship. However, Lhagva chose to disobey the order and he remained on the ''Admonitor'', because he wanted to save the Quesoth from Esva and because he was an orphan, so he had no family to dishonor by remaining behind. Shortly afterward, the battle commenced, and Lhagva and his stormtrooper [[Squad/Legends|squad]] landed on Quethold and entered the [[Red City]] aboard an [[A-rack]] carrier vehicle. The stormtroopers were then attacked by a large group of Quesoth [[Quesoth Soldier|Soldiers]] in the street [[Setting Sun Avenue]].
